amazon-product-image.name: Amazon Seller Central (product images)
amazon-product-image.notes: Longest side minimum 1000px (1600px+ zoom). 2000px+ recommended. Main image must fill 85%+ of frame on white background.

etsy-listing-image.name: Etsy listing photos
etsy-listing-image.notes: Etsy recommends 2000px on the shortest side. Up to 20 images per listing.

ozon-product-card.name: Ozon product card
ozon-product-card.background: white or neutral for main photo
ozon-product-card.notes: Minimum 200×200px; 900×1200px or larger recommended for clothing and general catalog cards.

shopify-product.name: Shopify product media
shopify-product.notes: Many Shopify themes treat ~2048×2048 as a strong retina product master. CDN serves responsive sizes after upload; keep a sharp square-biased JPEG under ~20 MB.

ebay-listing.name: eBay listing photos
ebay-listing.notes: 1600×1600 is a widely cited working floor for sharp eBay gallery zoom. Practical ~12 MB guardrail keeps multi-angle lots manageable in Seller Hub.

instagram-feed.name: Instagram feed posts
instagram-feed.notes: Classic feed squares land at 1080×1080. Prep under ~8 MB so the app’s recompression starts from a clean master instead of a 4K dump.

facebook-catalog.name: Facebook / Meta catalog images
facebook-catalog.notes: Catalog and dynamic-ad squares commonly aim near 1200×1200. Keep under ~8 MB for Commerce Manager uploads and ad creative swaps.

walmart-marketplace.name: Walmart Marketplace product images
walmart-marketplace.notes: Walmart expects catalog-grade pixels near 2000×2000 but weight limits feel tighter than Amazon — practical ~5 MB JPEG at quality ~78.

wildberries-card.name: Wildberries product card
wildberries-card.background: white or light for main card
wildberries-card.notes: Portrait 3:4 cards around 900×1200 match Wildberries cabinet layouts better than Western 1:1 marketplace masters.

aliexpress-product.name: AliExpress product images
aliexpress-product.notes: AliExpress listing rails often start near 800×800 with a hard practical weight cap around 5 MB — downscale studio RAWs before seller upload.

google-merchant.name: Google Merchant Center
google-merchant.background: product on white or lifestyle per feed rules
google-merchant.notes: Preferred Shopping images land near 1500×1500 (minimums are lower). Quality 85 keeps feed thumbnails sharp under a practical ~16 MB ceiling.

pinterest-pin.name: Pinterest standard pins
pinterest-pin.notes: Standard product pins thrive at 1000×1500 (2:3). Wide website heroes waste vertical real estate in the grid.

tiktok-shop.name: TikTok Shop product images
tiktok-shop.background: clean product square for Shop rails
tiktok-shop.notes: TikTok Shop stills commonly use an 800×800 square with a practical ~5 MB weight. Keep vertical video frames separate from this square product rail.
